description: This Java class 'StatusCodeMapper' provides utility methods for mapping HTTP and AMQP status/error codes to specific ServiceInvocationException subclasses, facilitating error handling in the Eclipse Hono client.

classes.name: StatusCodeMapper
classes.description: Utility class for mapping status codes to ServiceInvocationException instances.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if a given status code indicates a successful invocation (200-299).

methods.name: from (RequestResponseResult)
methods.description: Creates an exception based on the result's status code.

methods.name: from (RegistrationResult)
methods.description: Creates an exception based on registration result, including payload error message if available.

methods.name: from (int, String)
methods.description: Creates an exception based on a status code and detail message, mapping to specific exception types.

methods.name: from (ErrorCondition)
methods.description: Creates an exception based on an AMQP ErrorCondition.

methods.name: from (Symbol, String)
methods.description: Creates an exception based on an AMQP Symbol condition and description.
